newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 25.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The China Securities Regulatory Commission has revoked the business licenses of seven futures brokerages after they failed an annual examination.

- The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China's Shanghai branch signed contracts with five big state-owned enterprises, including Shanghai Tyre and Rubber Co Ltd, to lend a total of 902 million yuan ($108.67 million) and provide a package of financial services.

- BUSINESS NEWS - China's textile industry shows signs of recovery with the number of enterprises losing money falling to 56 percent of the total in the first five months of 1997, four percentage points lower than in the same 1996 period.
